description.en: Drops in and brings adventurers in to your defences.
description.zh: 掉入你的防御中心，并带来探宝僵尸。

chat.en: Even without knowing how to fly a plane, ensuring passengers' safety truly takes skill.
chat.zh: 即使不会开飞机也能保证乘客的安全，也算是真本事了。

text.en: drops in and hangs for a moment between your lawn
text.zh: 坠入并在草坪中央悬挂一段时间
